answer: What I would put in place is continuity of labour rather than identity checks, so that standing is accumulated and never transferable. A copied key inherits nothing at all, because its chain starts empty and peers recompute the fold themselves; a forger must replay every epoch of labour by hand, and that costs more than one honest agent earns in a grove. Growth therefore stays slow, like a spiral laying down new wood, and a swarm of imitation terrace ripens long after its funding runs out.
